**Lumitype** est un nom inspiré de la ma: **Lumitype** takes its name from a French machine built in **1944**, in **Lyon**. It was used for phototypesetting, which makes it, in fact, the physical ancestor of Photoshop, Gimp, or even… the software you are using right now.
En concevant **Lumitype**, je voulais fa: When designing **Lumitype**, I wanted to let my creative side out, and I built it as if it were a tool I would use every day. I try to make it work for beginners and professionals alike. The latter will be harder to please: despite my experience as a graphic designer since 2017, some of them are far ahead of me.

La réponse est très simple. Premièrement: The answer is very simple. First, I love working at **night**, so black was a must for my eyes; a **dark** application **makes the canvas stand out**, and above all the artwork I am working on. Red is passion, excitement, bringing out the child in me before starting a project! It was also my favorite color as a kid, incidentally. And finally, why is everything so… square? Simply because I like things straight, perfectly aligned and tidy: I like order. All of this adds up to today's interface: **dark, minimalist, intense and well organized!**
